form.label: IRIS — Peer-to-Peer Distribution (measured peer tracing)
form.description: Does P2P actually carry load, how much, and among whom. Byte totals come from the durable peer ledger, so a finished transfer keeps its history and no panel goes blank when the swarm goes idle. Every derived number says so in its own title.

input.label: Window (drives EVERY panel — see the provenance panel before quoting a number)

search.query: | mcatalog values(image) AS image WHERE index=iris_metrics metric_name IN ("iris_origin_sent_bytes_total","iris_origin_sent_bytes","iris_peer_attributed_bytes_total","iris_peer_attributed_bytes") | mvexpand image | fields image

| mstats latest(_value) AS v WHERE index=iris_metrics metric_name IN ("iris_origin_sent_bytes_total","iris_origin_sent_bytes","iris_peer_attributed_bytes_total","iris_peer_attributed_bytes","iris_peer_unattributed_bytes_total","iris_peer_unattributed_bytes","iris_swarm_peers_attributed","iris_swarm_peers_saturated") AND image="$img$" BY metric_name, image, info_hash | eval fam=replace(metric_name,"_total$","")
| mstats latest(_value) AS v WHERE index=iris_metrics metric_name="iris_seeder_rpc_up"
| where fam=="iris_origin_sent_bytes" | stats sum(v) AS b | eval MiB=round(b/1048576,1) | fields MiB

single.option: MiB, all-time cumulative — the origin seeder's own aria2 upload counter, banked monotonically by the peer ledger. Not a window delta: it does not move when you drag the time picker. Wire bytes, so re-sends of hashfailed pieces count.

search.query: | where fam=="iris_peer_attributed_bytes" | stats sum(v) AS b | eval MiB=round(b/1048576,1) | fields MiB

single.option: MiB, all-time cumulative — origin bytes the ledger pinned to a specific peer IP, summed over every (info_hash, peer) edge. Measured per connection from aria2's own counters.

search.query: | where fam=="iris_peer_unattributed_bytes" | stats sum(v) AS b | eval MiB=round(b/1048576,1) | fields MiB

single.option: MiB, all-time cumulative value — origin bytes that went out but could not be traced to a device: connections that opened and closed between two polls, plus peers refused at the ledger cap. This is NOT a rate. The series can step DOWN, because it is a difference of two counters and late tracing retires residue; a step down is not a counter reset.

search.query: | stats sum(eval(if(fam=="iris_peer_attributed_bytes",v,null()))) AS a, sum(eval(if(fam=="iris_origin_sent_bytes",v,null()))) AS o | eval excess=if(isnull(a) OR isnull(o),null(),max(0,a-o)) | eval MiB=if(isnull(excess),null(),round(excess/1048576,1)) | fields MiB

single.option: MiB = max(0, traced − origin sent). The ledger floors the residue at 0, so bytes traced to peers beyond what the origin measured sending would otherwise show up as the comfortable "residue 0 / coverage 100%". Anything above 0 means something double-banked: treat coverage as an upper bound and the per-peer edge table as suspect for that torrent until it returns to 0.

search.query: | stats sum(eval(if(fam=="iris_peer_attributed_bytes",v,null()))) AS a, sum(eval(if(fam=="iris_origin_sent_bytes",v,null()))) AS o | eval pct=if(isnull(a) OR isnull(o) OR o<=0,null(),round(100*a/o,1)) | fields pct

single.option: traced ÷ origin-sent, as a percentage. 100% = every origin byte could be traced to a device. Below 100% is the untraced residue — bytes that certainly went out, recipient unknown. Above 100% is not good news — it means more bytes were traced to peers than the origin measured sending; see "Over-tracing excess (derived)".

panel.title: Peers with bytes traced to them

search.query: | where fam=="iris_swarm_peers_attributed" | stats sum(v) AS n | fields n

single.option: distinct peers holding a nonzero ledger total, summed across every {image, info_hash} series — a peer that took two torrents of the same image counts twice. NOT comparable to the tracker's announce-derived Peers: different population, different source.

search.query: | where fam=="iris_swarm_peers_saturated" | stats max(v) AS saturated | fields saturated

single.option: 1 when the per-torrent peer cap refused new peers, so part of the untraced residue is refused peers rather than short-lived connections. Blank means the flag was not exported — that is not proof of "not saturated".

search.query: | stats max(v) AS v | fields v

single.option: liveness — 0 here means the board is blind, not that the swarm is idle

search.query: search index=iris_logs source=iris sourcetype=otel:logs "otel.log.name"="iris.device.transfer.report" "iris.report.event" IN ("staging-complete","seeding-only","pull") | eval img_cat=replace("$img$","\.SPA\.bin$|\.bin$","") | where 'iris.image.id'==img_cat OR "$img$"=="*" | eval got=tonumber('iris.transfer.completed_content_bytes') | stats max(got) AS got BY "device.id" | stats sum(got) AS delivered, dc("device.id") AS devices | eval MiB=if(isnull(delivered),null(),round(delivered/1048576,1)) | fields MiB

| mstats latest(_value) AS v WHERE index=iris_metrics metric_name IN ("iris_origin_sent_bytes_total","iris_origin_sent_bytes") AND image="$img$" BY image, info_hash | stats sum(v) AS origin | appendcols [ search index=iris_logs source=iris sourcetype=otel:logs "otel.log.name"="iris.device.transfer.report" "iris.report.event" IN ("staging-complete","seeding-only","pull") | eval img_cat=replace("$img$","\.SPA\.bin$|\.bin$","") | where 'iris.image.id'==img_cat OR "$img$"=="*" | eval got=tonumber('iris.transfer.completed_content_bytes') | stats max(got) AS got BY "device.id" | stats sum(got) AS delivered ] | eval peers=if(isnull(origin) OR isnull(delivered), null(), delivered-origin) | eval "Origin (measured)"=if(isnull(peers),null(),round(origin/1048576,1)), "From peers (derived)"=if(isnull(peers),null(),round(max(peers,0)/1048576,1)) | fields "Origin (measured)", "From peers (derived)" | transpose 0 column_name=Source | rename "row 1" AS MiB

| mstats latest(_value) AS v WHERE index=iris_metrics metric_name IN ("iris_origin_sent_bytes_total","iris_origin_sent_bytes") AND image="$img$" BY image, info_hash | stats sum(v) AS origin | appendcols [ search index=iris_logs source=iris sourcetype=otel:logs "otel.log.name"="iris.device.transfer.report" "iris.report.event" IN ("staging-complete","seeding-only","pull") | eval img_cat=replace("$img$","\.SPA\.bin$|\.bin$","") | where 'iris.image.id'==img_cat OR "$img$"=="*" | eval got=tonumber('iris.transfer.completed_content_bytes') | stats max(got) AS got BY "device.id" | stats sum(got) AS delivered ] | eval peers=if(isnull(origin) OR isnull(delivered), null(), delivered-origin) | eval pct=if(isnull(peers) OR isnull(delivered) OR delivered<=0, null(), round(100*peers/delivered,1)) | fields pct

panel.title: Cumulative bytes — durable ledger staircase (survives a finished transfer; filldown means idle reads flat, never blank)

search.query: | mstats latest(_value) AS v WHERE index=iris_metrics metric_name IN ("iris_origin_sent_bytes_total","iris_origin_sent_bytes","iris_peer_attributed_bytes_total","iris_peer_attributed_bytes","iris_peer_unattributed_bytes_total","iris_peer_unattributed_bytes") AND image="$img$" span=60s BY metric_name, image, info_hash | eval fam=replace(metric_name,"_total$","") | stats sum(v) AS v BY _time, fam | eval MiB=round(v/1048576,2) | timechart span=60s max(MiB) BY fam | filldown | rename iris_origin_sent_bytes AS "Origin sent (measured)", iris_peer_attributed_bytes AS "Traced to a device (measured)", iris_peer_unattributed_bytes AS "Untraced residue (measured)"

panel.title: Origin upload rate (measured)
panel.description: Bytes/s leaving the origin seeder, from iris_seeder_torrent_upload_bytes_per_second (the origin's own aria2 RPC poll), per torrent. Origin to swarm only: it is a LOWER BOUND on total swarm throughput, because device-to-device reseed traffic is invisible from the origin. No samples in range renders "no data", never 0.

search.query: | mstats avg(_value) AS bps WHERE index=iris_metrics metric_name="iris_seeder_torrent_upload_bytes_per_second" AND image="$img$" span=60s BY image | timechart span=60s avg(bps) BY image

panel.title: Traced origin to peer delivery, per torrent (MEASURED ledger deltas, MiB/min)

search.query: index=iris_logs "otel.log.name"="iris.swarm.peer_bytes" ("iris.image.id"=$img$ OR $img$="*") | eval d=tonumber('iris.transfer.peer_sent_delta_bytes')/1048576 | timechart span=60s sum(d) BY "iris.image.id"

panel.title: Tracing coverage (derived, % of origin bytes) — over time

search.query: | mstats latest(_value) AS v WHERE index=iris_metrics metric_name IN ("iris_peer_attributed_bytes_total","iris_peer_attributed_bytes","iris_origin_sent_bytes_total","iris_origin_sent_bytes") AND image="$img$" span=300s BY metric_name, image, info_hash | eval fam=replace(metric_name,"_total$","") | stats sum(v) AS v BY _time, fam | timechart span=300s max(v) BY fam | filldown | eval Coverage=if(isnull(iris_peer_attributed_bytes) OR isnull(iris_origin_sent_bytes) OR iris_origin_sent_bytes<=0,null(),round(100*iris_peer_attributed_bytes/iris_origin_sent_bytes,1)) | fields _time, Coverage

chart.option: % of origin bytes traced to a device

search.query: search index=iris_logs source=iris sourcetype=otel:logs "otel.log.name"="iris.swarm.peer_rate" ("iris.image.id"=$img$ OR $img$="*") | eval bps=tonumber('iris.transfer.peer_send_bps') | timechart span=60s avg(bps) BY "network.peer.address"

| mstats latest(_value) AS v WHERE index=iris_metrics metric_name IN ("iris_swarm_peers","iris_swarm_seeders","iris_swarm_leechers","iris_swarm_bytes_remaining","iris_transfer_devices","iris_transfer_freshness_age_seconds","iris_swarm_peers_attributed","iris_origin_sent_bytes_total","iris_origin_sent_bytes","iris_peer_attributed_bytes_total","iris_peer_attributed_bytes","iris_peer_unattributed_bytes_total","iris_peer_unattributed_bytes") AND image="$img$" BY metric_name, image | eval metric_name=replace(metric_name,"_total$","") | xyseries image metric_name v | eval "Origin MiB"=round(iris_origin_sent_bytes/1048576,1), "Traced MiB"=round(iris_peer_attributed_bytes/1048576,1), "Residue MiB"=round(iris_peer_unattributed_bytes/1048576,1), "Remaining GiB"=round(iris_swarm_bytes_remaining/1073741824,2) | rename image AS Image, iris_swarm_peers AS Peers, iris_swarm_seeders AS Seeders, iris_swarm_leechers AS Leechers, iris_transfer_devices AS Devices, iris_swarm_peers_attributed AS "Traced peers", iris_transfer_freshness_age_seconds AS "Age (s)" | fields Image, Peers, Seeders, Leechers, Devices, "Traced peers", "Origin MiB", "Traced MiB", "Residue MiB", "Remaining GiB", "Age (s)" | sort Image

panel.title: Swarm population (measured)
panel.description: iris_swarm_peers / iris_swarm_seeders / iris_swarm_leechers, announce-derived per {image, info_hash} (a seeder is a device that announced left==0). This is a DIFFERENT population from "Peers with bytes traced to them", which counts ledger edges: the two must never be differenced or plotted as a coverage ratio. No announces in range renders "no data", never 0.

search.query: | mstats latest(_value) AS v WHERE index=iris_metrics metric_name IN ("iris_swarm_seeders","iris_swarm_leechers","iris_swarm_peers") AND image="$img$" span=60s BY metric_name, image | timechart span=60s max(v) BY metric_name

panel.title: Bytes remaining in the swarm (measured)
panel.description: iris_swarm_bytes_remaining: the sum of `left` across leechers at announce time, per torrent. It falls to 0 for an idle swarm with no leechers — that 0 is a MEASURED zero (nobody is announcing a remainder), not proof of completion, and a device that stops announcing silently leaves the total. No series in range renders "no data".

search.query: | mstats latest(_value) AS v WHERE index=iris_metrics metric_name="iris_swarm_bytes_remaining" AND image="$img$" span=60s BY image | timechart span=60s max(v) BY image

| mstats avg(_value) AS bps WHERE index=iris_metrics metric_name="iris_transfer_throughput_bytes_per_second" AND direction="receive" AND image="$img$" span=60s BY image | eval MiBs=round(bps/1048576,3) | timechart span=60s avg(MiBs) BY image

panel.title: Devices that completed the image (measured)
panel.description: iris_swarm_completed_total, the tracker's completion counter, summed across every {image, info_hash}. In-memory with a 24 h TTL and process-lifetime scope, so a tracker restart resets it. This count must NEVER be multiplied by an image size to produce a byte figure — fleet delivery is measured from device reports instead. No counter in range renders "no data", never 0.

search.query: | mstats latest(_value) AS v WHERE index=iris_metrics metric_name IN ("iris_swarm_completed_total","iris_swarm_completed") AND image="$img$" BY image, info_hash | stats sum(v) AS completed | fields completed

single.option: devices reported complete by the tracker

panel.title: Image size (measured)
panel.description: iris_image_size_bytes{image,info_hash}, sourced from the catalog entry's own `size` field. Emitted by the hub from the catalog store. A missing series means that image has no published catalog entry; the panel reads "no data" rather than guessing. There is no hardcoded constant, no textbox fallback and no substitute — the retired image_size_bytes textbox input was deleted for exactly that reason. Informational and progress-only: the fleet-delivery totals on this board are defined so they never depend on it.

search.query: | mstats latest(_value) AS v WHERE index=iris_metrics metric_name="iris_image_size_bytes" AND image="$img$" BY image, info_hash

panel.title: Telemetry export health (measured)
panel.description: iris_telemetry_export_dropped_total, iris_telemetry_export_failures_total and iris_telemetry_export_last_success_seconds, per signal. This panel is the honesty gate for every log-derived byte quantity on this board ("Delivered to the fleet", "Delivered peer to peer", "Peer share of delivery, per device", and both per-peer origin-byte panels): those totals are read out of exported OTLP log records, so a NONZERO drop or failure count means they are FLOORS, not totals, and a stale last-success timestamp means they stopped moving for a reason that has nothing to do with the swarm. No export metrics ingested renders "no data" — which is itself unknown health, not good health.

search.query: | mstats latest(_value) AS v WHERE index=iris_metrics metric_name IN ("iris_telemetry_export_dropped_total","iris_telemetry_export_failures_total","iris_telemetry_export_last_success_seconds") BY metric_name, signal

panel.title: Origin bytes to this peer (measured, cumulative)

search.query: search index=iris_logs source=iris sourcetype=otel:logs "otel.log.name"="iris.swarm.peer_bytes" ("iris.image.id"=$img$ OR $img$="*") | eval sent=tonumber('iris.transfer.peer_sent_bytes') | eval dev=if(isnull('iris.device.id') OR 'iris.device.id'=="","unresolved",'iris.device.id') | stats max(sent) AS edge, latest("iris.peer.role") AS role BY "network.peer.address", "iris.torrent.info_hash", dev | stats sum(edge) AS bytes, latest(role) AS role BY "network.peer.address", dev | rename "network.peer.address" AS Peer, dev AS Device, role AS Role | eval "MiB from origin"=round(bytes/1048576,1) | fields Peer, Device, Role, "MiB from origin" | sort - "MiB from origin" | appendpipe [ stats count AS n | where n==0 | eval Peer="— no peer_bytes records in this window (no transfer ran, or the ledger has not emitted yet) —" | fields Peer ]

panel.title: Origin bytes to this peer, in range (derived)

search.query: search index=iris_logs source=iris sourcetype=otel:logs "otel.log.name"="iris.swarm.peer_bytes" ("iris.image.id"=$img$ OR $img$="*") | eval sent=tonumber('iris.transfer.peer_sent_bytes') | eval dev=if(isnull('iris.device.id') OR 'iris.device.id'=="","unresolved",'iris.device.id') | stats max(sent) AS hi, min(sent) AS lo BY "network.peer.address", "iris.torrent.info_hash", dev | eval edge=hi-lo | stats sum(edge) AS bytes BY dev | rename dev AS Device | eval "MiB in range"=round(bytes/1048576,1) | fields Device, "MiB in range" | sort - "MiB in range" | appendpipe [ stats count AS n | where n==0 | eval Device="— no peer_bytes records in this window —" | fields Device ]

panel.title: Role split — bytes to seeders vs leechers (role is MEASURED, from aria2 isSeeder)

search.query: index=iris_logs "otel.log.name"="iris.swarm.peer_bytes" ("iris.image.id"=$img$ OR $img$="*") | eval sent=tonumber('iris.transfer.peer_sent_bytes') | stats max(sent) AS edge, latest("iris.peer.role") AS role BY "network.peer.address", "iris.torrent.info_hash" | stats sum(edge) AS bytes, dc("network.peer.address") AS Peers BY role | eval MiB=round(bytes/1048576,1) | rename role AS Role | fields Role, Peers, MiB | sort - MiB | appendpipe [ stats count AS n | where n==0 | eval Role="— no peer_bytes records in this window —" | fields Role ]

panel.title: Peer share of delivery, per device (derived, %)

search.query: search index=iris_logs source=iris sourcetype=otel:logs "otel.log.name"="iris.swarm.peer_bytes" ("iris.image.id"=$img$ OR $img$="*") "iris.device.id"=* | eval sent=tonumber('iris.transfer.peer_sent_bytes') | stats max(sent) AS edge BY "network.peer.address", "iris.torrent.info_hash", "iris.device.id" | stats sum(edge) AS origin_to_dev BY "iris.device.id" | rename "iris.device.id" AS "device.id" | append [ search index=iris_logs source=iris sourcetype=otel:logs "otel.log.name"="iris.device.transfer.report" "iris.report.event" IN ("staging-complete","seeding-only","pull") | eval img_cat=replace("$img$","\.SPA\.bin$|\.bin$","") | where 'iris.image.id'==img_cat OR "$img$"=="*" | eval got=tonumber('iris.transfer.completed_content_bytes') | stats max(got) AS got BY "device.id" ] | stats max(origin_to_dev) AS origin_to_dev, max(got) AS got BY "device.id" | eval pct=if(isnull(origin_to_dev) OR isnull(got) OR got<=0, null(), round(100*(got-origin_to_dev)/got,1)) | eval "MiB from origin (measured)"=if(isnull(origin_to_dev),null(),round(origin_to_dev/1048576,1)), "MiB delivered (measured)"=if(isnull(got),null(),round(got/1048576,1)), "MiB from peers (derived)"=if(isnull(origin_to_dev) OR isnull(got),null(),round((got-origin_to_dev)/1048576,1)) | rename "device.id" AS Device, pct AS "Peer share % (derived)" | fields Device, "MiB from origin (measured)", "MiB delivered (measured)", "MiB from peers (derived)", "Peer share % (derived)" | sort - "Peer share % (derived)" | appendpipe [ stats count AS n | where n==0 | eval Device="— no peer_bytes edges and no device reports in this window —" | fields Device ]

index=iris_logs "otel.log.name"="iris.swarm.peer_bytes" ("iris.image.id"=$img$ OR $img$="*") | eval "Sent MiB"=round(tonumber('iris.transfer.peer_sent_bytes')/1048576,2), "Delta MiB"=round(tonumber('iris.transfer.peer_sent_delta_bytes')/1048576,3) | rename "iris.image.id" AS Image, "network.peer.address" AS Peer, "iris.device.id" AS Device, "iris.peer.role" AS Role, "iris.torrent.info_hash" AS "Info hash" | table _time, Image, Peer, Device, Role, "Sent MiB", "Delta MiB", "Info hash" | sort - _time | head 50 | appendpipe [ stats count AS n | where n==0 | eval Image="— no peer_bytes records in this window —" | fields Image ]

panel.title: Provenance — what is measured, what is arithmetic, and what is missing

div.p: Measured. Per-peer bytes come from aria2-next 2.5.6's getPeers, which exposes a per-connection cumulative uploaded counter. IRIS samples it and accumulates the result into a durable ledger, so the totals here are observations, not estimates. Peer role is aria2's own isSeeder.

Ephemeral source, hence the untraced residue. The origin knows exactly how many bytes it uploaded; what needs a live connection is naming which device received them. getPeers only returns live connections, so a peer that connects, takes bytes and leaves between two samples takes its counter with it: those bytes certainly went out, but no recipient can be named for them. Measured origin-side capture: 73.3% at 3 s sampling, 88.1% at 2 s. The shortfall is published as the untraced-residue counter and shown on this board rather than being folded silently into someone's total. Traced + untraced = the origin's own upload counter.

Derived, and labelled as such. Every "from peers" figure on this board is device-reported delivered bytes minus the measured origin contribution — arithmetic on two measured quantities, not an observation of peer-to-peer traffic. IRIS cannot see device-to-device transfers directly; the origin is structurally blind to them. Treat it as a floor.

Window sensitivity. The ledger tiles do not depend on the window: they report the all-time cumulative counter value, so a finished transfer keeps its history however the time picker is dragged. The event-side panels still depend on which reports land in-window, and a device's terminal report arrives at completion, so a window that clips the end of a transfer understates the peer share. For a rollout, pick a window that fully contains it.

Peer cap. The ledger caps distinct peers per torrent. When that cap is reached the excess peers stop being tracked individually and their bytes fall into the untraced residue. This is measured directly: Peer ledger cap saturated reads 1 while the cap is refusing peers, which is the only way to tell refused peers apart from missed short-lived connections inside the residue.
Idle is not broken. Counters keep their last value, so a finished transfer stays on screen. If Seeder RPC reads 0, the board is blind and every other panel on it is stale.
